pairs.evidence: lib/imaging/video/leonardo.ts:54 The vendor clip canvas table grades each size by provenance: 856×480 is measured, 9:16 is marked assumed, and square and 4:5 are refused at the route instead of guessed. Only two of the six techniques apply to these vendor adapters.
